##############################################################
## PW Boards..
##
## Note that the variant field is used to pick up the pins_arduino.h from the
## associated folder in esp32/hardware/esp32/3.1.0/variants
##
## Add a new custom menu item

menu.TVMGadget=ThermaV Gadget Config
menu.TVMGRevision=ThermaV Boards Revision

##############################################################

tvmg_esp32.name=TVMG ESP32 Gadget
tvmg_esp32.build.tmvgdefs=-DTVMG_PROJECT
tvmg_esp32.build.tmvgcustom=-DTVMG_ESP32 -DTVMG_SPIFFS -DTVMG_OLED

# Standard options

tvmg_esp32.bootloader.tool=esptool_py
tvmg_esp32.bootloader.tool.default=esptool_py

tvmg_esp32.upload.tool=esptool_py
tvmg_esp32.upload.tool.default=esptool_py
tvmg_esp32.upload.tool.network=esp_ota
tvmg_esp32.upload.maximum_size=1769472
tvmg_esp32.upload.maximum_data_size=327680
tvmg_esp32.upload.flags=
tvmg_esp32.upload.extra_flags=
tvmg_esp32.upload.speed=921600
tvmg_esp32.upload.erase_cmd=

tvmg_esp32.serial.disableDTR=true
tvmg_esp32.serial.disableRTS=true

tvmg_esp32.build.tarch=xtensa
tvmg_esp32.build.bootloader_addr=0x1000
tvmg_esp32.build.target=esp32
tvmg_esp32.build.mcu=esp32
tvmg_esp32.build.core=esp32
tvmg_esp32.build.variant=esp32
tvmg_esp32.build.board=gadget1

tvmg_esp32.build.f_cpu=240000000L
tvmg_esp32.build.flash_size=4MB
tvmg_esp32.build.flash_freq=80m
tvmg_esp32.build.flash_mode=dio
tvmg_esp32.build.boot=dio
tvmg_esp32.build.partitions=4MB_ota_512KB_spiffs

tvmg_esp32.build.loop_core=-DARDUINO_RUNNING_CORE=1
tvmg_esp32.build.event_core=-DARDUINO_EVENT_RUNNING_CORE=1

tvmg_esp32.build.copy_jtag_files=0

# Menu to select board type, not really necessary

tvmg_esp32.menu.TVMGadget.tnode=TNode
tvmg_esp32.menu.TVMGadget.tnode.tmvg.subtype=-DTNODE
tvmg_esp32.menu.TVMGadget.master=master
tvmg_esp32.menu.TVMGadget.master.tmvg.subtype=-DMASTER
tvmg_esp32.menu.TVMGadget.external=external
tvmg_esp32.menu.TVMGadget.external.tmvg.subtype=-DEXTERNAL

# The FQDN will have TVMGRevision=v1, the 'version 1' is shown in the menu

tvmg_esp32.menu.TVMGRevision.v2=version 2

# Debug selection

tvmg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.none=None
tvmg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.none.build.code_debug=0
tvmg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.error=Error
tvmg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.error.build.code_debug=1
tvmg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.warn=Warn
tvmg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.warn.build.code_debug=2
tvmg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.info=Info
tvmg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.info.build.code_debug=3
tvmg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.debug=Debug
tvmg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.debug.build.code_debug=4
tvmg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.verbose=Verbose
tvmg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.verbose.build.code_debug=5

# Using the legacy TVMG_ESP32

tvmg_esp32.build.defines={build.tmvgdefs} {build.tmvgcustom} {tmvg.subtype}

##############################################################

tvmg_wsharelcd.name=TVMG Waveshare LCD
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.tmvgdefs=-DTVMG_PROJECT
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.tmvgcustom=-DTVMG_WAVESHARE_LCDB -DTVMG_LITTLEFS

tvmg_wsharelcd.vid.0=0x303a
tvmg_wsharelcd.pid.0=0x8231
tvmg_wsharelcd.upload_port.0.vid=0x303a
tvmg_wsharelcd.upload_port.0.pid=0x8231

tvmg_wsharelcd.bootloader.tool=esptool_py
tvmg_wsharelcd.bootloader.tool.default=esptool_py

tvmg_wsharelcd.upload.tool=esptool_py
tvmg_wsharelcd.upload.tool.default=esptool_py
tvmg_wsharelcd.upload.tool.network=esp_ota
tvmg_wsharelcd.upload.maximum_size=4718592
tvmg_wsharelcd.upload.maximum_data_size=327680
tvmg_wsharelcd.upload.flags=
tvmg_wsharelcd.upload.extra_flags=
tvmg_wsharelcd.upload.erase_cmd=
tvmg_wsharelcd.upload.use_1200bps_touch=false
tvmg_wsharelcd.upload.wait_for_upload_port=false
tvmg_wsharelcd.upload.speed=921600

tvmg_wsharelcd.serial.disableDTR=false
tvmg_wsharelcd.serial.disableRTS=false

tvmg_wsharelcd.build.tarch=xtensa
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.bootloader_addr=0x0
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.target=esp32s3
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.mcu=esp32s3
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.core=esp32
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.variant=waveshare_esp32_s3_touch_lcd_43b
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.board=WAVESHARE_ESP32_S3_TOUCH_LCD_43B

tvmg_wsharelcd.build.usb_mode=1
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.cdc_on_boot=1
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.msc_on_boot=0
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.dfu_on_boot=0
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.f_cpu=240000000L

tvmg_wsharelcd.build.flash_size=16MB
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.flash_freq=80m
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.flash_mode=dio
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.boot=qio
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.boot_freq=80m

tvmg_wsharelcd.build.psram_type=opi
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.psram_defines=-DBOARD_HAS_PSRAM
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.memory_type={build.boot}_{build.psram_type}

tvmg_wsharelcd.build.partitions=large_spiffs_16MB

tvmg_wsharelcd.build.loop_core=-DARDUINO_RUNNING_CORE=1
tvmg_wsharelcd.build.event_core=-DARDUINO_EVENT_RUNNING_CORE=1

tvmg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.none=None
tvmg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.none.build.code_debug=0
tvmg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.error=Error
tvmg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.error.build.code_debug=1
tvmg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.warn=Warn
tvmg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.warn.build.code_debug=2
tvmg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.info=Info
tvmg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.info.build.code_debug=3
tvmg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.debug=Debug
tvmg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.debug.build.code_debug=4
tvmg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.verbose=Verbose
tvmg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.verbose.build.code_debug=5


# The FQDN will have TVMGRevision=v1, the 'version 1' is shown in the menu

tvmg_wsharelcd.menu.TVMGRevision.v2=version 2

tvmg_wsharelcd.build.defines={build.tmvgdefs} {build.tmvgcustom} {build.psram_defines}

tvmg_esp32s3.name=TVMG ESP32S3

tvmg_esp32s3.build.tmvgdefs=-DTVMG_PROJECT
tvmg_esp32s3.build.tmvgcustom=-DTVMG_ESP32S3 -DTVMG_RS485 -DTVMG_LITTLEFS -DTVMG_RGBLED

tvmg_esp32s3.bootloader.tool=esptool_py
tvmg_esp32s3.bootloader.tool.default=esptool_py

tvmg_esp32s3.upload.tool=esptool_py
tvmg_esp32s3.upload.tool.default=esptool_py
tvmg_esp32s3.upload.tool.network=esp_ota
tvmg_esp32s3.upload.maximum_size=4718592
tvmg_esp32s3.upload.maximum_data_size=327680
tvmg_esp32s3.upload.flags=
tvmg_esp32s3.upload.extra_flags=
tvmg_esp32s3.upload.erase_cmd=
tvmg_esp32s3.upload.use_1200bps_touch=false
tvmg_esp32s3.upload.wait_for_upload_port=false
tvmg_esp32s3.upload.speed=921600

tvmg_esp32s3.serial.disableDTR=false
tvmg_esp32s3.serial.disableRTS=false

tvmg_esp32s3.build.tarch=xtensa
tvmg_esp32s3.build.bootloader_addr=0x0
tvmg_esp32s3.build.target=esp32s3
tvmg_esp32s3.build.mcu=esp32s3
tvmg_esp32s3.build.core=esp32
tvmg_esp32s3.build.variant=esp32s3
tvmg_esp32s3.build.board=TVMG_S3

# Using COM port for serial not USB, so CDC disabled

tvmg_esp32s3.build.usb_mode=1
tvmg_esp32s3.build.cdc_on_boot=0
tvmg_esp32s3.build.msc_on_boot=0
tvmg_esp32s3.build.dfu_on_boot=0
tvmg_esp32s3.build.f_cpu=240000000L

tvmg_esp32s3.build.flash_size=16MB
tvmg_esp32s3.build.flash_freq=80m
tvmg_esp32s3.build.flash_mode=dio
tvmg_esp32s3.build.boot=qio
tvmg_esp32s3.build.boot_freq=80m

tvmg_esp32s3.build.psram_type=opi
tvmg_esp32s3.build.psram_defines=-DBOARD_HAS_PSRAM
tvmg_esp32s3.build.memory_type={build.boot}_{build.psram_type}

tvmg_esp32s3.build.partitions=large_spiffs_16MB

tvmg_esp32s3.build.loop_core=-DARDUINO_RUNNING_CORE=1
tvmg_esp32s3.build.event_core=-DARDUINO_EVENT_RUNNING_CORE=1

tvmg_esp32s3.menu.DebugLevel.none=None
tvmg_esp32s3.menu.DebugLevel.none.build.code_debug=0
tvmg_esp32s3.menu.DebugLevel.error=Error
tvmg_esp32s3.menu.DebugLevel.error.build.code_debug=1
tvmg_esp32s3.menu.DebugLevel.warn=Warn
tvmg_esp32s3.menu.DebugLevel.warn.build.code_debug=2
tvmg_esp32s3.menu.DebugLevel.info=Info
tvmg_esp32s3.menu.DebugLevel.info.build.code_debug=3
tvmg_esp32s3.menu.DebugLevel.debug=Debug
tvmg_esp32s3.menu.DebugLevel.debug.build.code_debug=4
tvmg_esp32s3.menu.DebugLevel.verbose=Verbose
tvmg_esp32s3.menu.DebugLevel.verbose.build.code_debug=5

# The FQDN will have TVMGRevision=v1, the 'version 1' is shown in the menu

tvmg_esp32s3.menu.TVMGRevision.v3=version 3

tvmg_esp32s3.build.defines={build.tmvgdefs} {build.tmvgcustom} {build.psram_defines}
